description: This file serves as the entry point for a React application. It imports React and ReactDOM libraries, includes a CSS file for styling, imports the main App component, and renders the App component into the root DOM element within the React StrictMode wrapper.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root React node in the specified DOM element for rendering React components.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders a React element into the created root.
